body:
"Suppose you asked leftists to make a list of ALL the things that were wrong
with society, and then suppose you instituted EVERY social change that they
demanded. It is safe to say that within a couple of years the majority of
leftists would find something new to complain about, some new social 'evil'
to correct because, once again, the leftist is motivated less by distress at
society's ills than by the need to satisfy his drive for power by imposing
his solutions on society." (Paragraph 220)


For those who feel offended by my thrashing of Steven "The Liar" Spielberg,
you can simply ignore this post.  That said, I have found that "Schlinder's
List" is also a fraud (I wrote about "Amistad" earlier.)  It turns out that
Schindler's widow, now residing in Argentina, is saying the movie was an
exaggeration and a piece of garbage.

This is quite a different story from what students learn in high schools
across the country, what Geraldo Rivera spews to his IQ 90 audience, what
Harvard academics drivel... basically from what is "politically correct."

Now I can imagine an asinine allegation thrown at me, such as: "He's denying
the holocaust!"  Of course I'm not, the issue I am bringing up is the
manipulation of the public mind.

Here are some comments made by Emilie Schindler:

"There never was a 'Schindler's List'. It was drawn up by a man called
Goldman. This man took money to put a name on that list - no money, no place
on the list. I was told this by a Dr Schwartz, in Vienna; he had paid in
diamonds to save his wife..."

"Hah! Neither of us [Emilie and Oskar] was a hero.."

"Oskar was always complex; he was playing both extremes, always, even at the
end with Nazis against the Jews."


So there you have it, there was NO SCHINDLER'S LIST.

Now, some may argue, "Well, okay, so what if there was no Schindler's List?
The point is that there was a holocaust, and if there is an error or two in
the movie, or if some things are fabricated, that is not such a big deal so
long as it makes people aware of what happened.  Never again should another
holocaust occur."

Well, first off, there have always been, and will always continue to be,
holocausts.  With awareness perhaps we might be able to reduce the number,
to promote more unity among mankind.  But, I have a problem with Jews trying
to monopolize the word holocaust, to make it seem as though what has been
done to them has not been done to any other group over the course of human
history -- and that they haven't committed any holocausts against other
people!  Their "ethnic cleansing" of the Palestinians, their
disproportionate role in Black slavery, their artificially-induced famine
against the Ukranians in which 7-10 million died (at least 50% of communist
officials in the Soviet Union were Jewish, despite being less than 2% of the
population) say otherwise.  Basically, I have a problem with Jews trying to
portray themselves as victims, and not showing the full context in which
anti-Semitism has grown in many nations.

Additionally, if there were some major fabrications made in the movie, which
is purported to be historically accurate by even college professors, it just
naturally makes you wonder what other falsities might have been spread -- as
well as the integrity of the people who propagate this misinformation.
